svg.title: Sony a6400 research status through E0300
svg.desc: 782 local tests pass. Original UIPC proxy threads and VBUS callback execute. Callback completion remains open. No emulator OSD mapping or verified GUI frame. Independent evidence, no overall compatibility percentage.

g.text: Research status
782 tests passed | Bounded contracts; full boot remains unproven
OFFLINE ORIGINAL CODE
UIPC / USB
Four proxy threads; original VBUS callback returns.
Open: completion ownership, sync delivery, control queue.
PHYSICAL CAPTURE + OFFLINE CONTRACT
Display / GPU
Camera OSD A/B confirmed; GPU is DMP SMAPH-S30.
Open: emulator OSD mappings, frame and rasterizer.
PHYSICAL OBSERVATION
PTP / composite USB
PC Remote sensor JPEG; composite enumeration demonstrated.
Open: composite frames and reliable teardown; paused.
AUTHORED PATTERN + PHYSICAL TRANSPORT
UVC / custom menu
Static 720p UVC at 29.9592 FPS; authored menu displayed.
Open: sensor feeder and original menu compatibility.
Independent results, not a compatibility percentage. Evidence and limits linked in README.
